newsitem.title: USA: Connecticut Natural Gas fears Jan weather.
newsitem.headline: Connecticut Natural Gas fears Jan weather.

text.p: Connecticut Natural Gas Corp said Tuesday warm January weather might affect its second quarter earnings.
"The regulated gas operation does not have a weather normalization clause in its rates so fluctuations in temperature from year to year can significantly impact earnings," it said.
The company reported first-quarter earnings of $0.63 a share against $0.82 a year ago.

"For the three months ended in December the temperature was five percent warmer than last year and one percent colder than normal," it said. "Of the drop in earnings, approximately $0.16 was due to the warmer weather."
First Call's consensus among analysts had been expecting first quarter earnings to be $0.70 a share.
The consensus forecast for all of fiscal 1997 is $1.85 a share for 1997.
